verdict.rationale: Mastra is a code-first TypeScript framework, and there is no first-party natural-language interface for operating it. Instead it supports operation in natural language indirectly, through the user's own AI coding assistant: the official @mastra/mcp-docs-server works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and similar tools, packages ship embedded docs that agents can read from node_modules, and llms.txt and docs.md are served for LLM consumption. Dynamic workflows can also be created by agents without code changes. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface or CLI for operating the framework or Studio, hands-on evidence of driving Mastra end-to-end via natural language, and independent corroboration.
